stories.title: Warriors' Porzingis to 'step away' from NBA to prioritize his health
stories.summary: Kristaps Porzingis has announced that he will "step away" from the NBA to prioritize his health. He has not played for the Warriors this season.

stories.title: Appeals court hands NCAA a victory in struggle for five-year eligibility rule
stories.summary: Federal appeals court judges handed the NCAA a significant victory in its struggle to implement a new five-year eligibility ruling Friday, though the win does nothing to tamp down dozens of similar lawsuits playing out in state courts across the country.

stories.title: Aiyuk meets with 49ers, says he's 'back to 100% and looking to get reinstated'
stories.summary: Brandon Aiyuk met with the Niners on Friday to begin hammering out a path toward a divorce that has been more than two years in the making.

stories.title: Witness: Clase 'inside' pitch info dried up amid Mizuhara case fallout
stories.summary: A witness said that the inside info he used to bet on Clase pitches dried up due to increased scrutiny from the scandal involving Shohei Ohtani's interpreter.

stories.title: Men's college soccer 2-semester model rejected by D-I schools
stories.summary: A proposal to split the men's college soccer season into two semesters starting in 2027-28 has failed after being rejected by NCAA's Division I schools.
